program.section_heading: Business Administration 2.0 Associate in Science for Transfer
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to analyze a business scenario and use numerical, graphical, symbolic, and verbal representations to effectively solve problems and communicate those solutions.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to analyze a business scenario and correctly prepare financial statements to effectively convey financial information for management decision-making.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to analyze a business scenario using the tools of economic theory to communicate economic effects on business decision-making.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to analyze a business scenario and appropriately apply business concepts in designing and managing business documents.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to analyze a business scenario and effectively explain the social, political, and ethical implications of the law to actual and hypothetical business transactions.
